name: Iris Detail
description: Analyzes iris pattern detail and consistency
algorithm: Iris Detail — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes iris detail and rendering quality for deepfake detection:

1. **虹彩領域抽出**: The iris is precisely segmented per frame using circular/elliptical fitting between pupil and limbus (iris-sclera boundary). The iris texture region is extracted and geometrically normalized to a canonical representation (polar coordinates, normalized radius).

2. **虹彩テクスチャ分析**: Natural iris texture contains complex radial structures (collarette, crypts, furrows, pigment spots) forming a unique biometric pattern. The method analyzes iris texture complexity, radial structure presence, and fine detail quality. AI-generated irises often lack the intricate natural iris texture, appearing either too smooth, too regular, or showing physically implausible patterns.

3. **Bilateral虹彩比較**: Both irises of the same person should show similar (but not identical) structural characteristics — same color, similar complexity, matching pigmentation patterns. The method compares iris features between eyes. Deepfakes may produce irises with inconsistent appearance (different colors, different detail levels) between left and right eyes.

4. **虹彩-瞳孔Dynamics**: The pupil-to-iris ratio should respond to light conditions. The method checks whether pupil size is consistent between both eyes and appropriate for the scene illumination. Deepfakes may produce asymmetric pupils or pupil sizes inconsistent with the lighting environment.

5. **時間的虹彩安定性**: Iris texture is a physical structure that doesn't change between frames — only viewing angle and pupil dilation change. The method tracks iris texture consistency (using iris code distance metrics) across frames. Frame-to-frame iris texture changes indicate AI generation where iris detail is independently rendered per frame.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through iris detail analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
